data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence across all sites with nearly the same parameters, but it leaves out the "review score 8+" hotel criterion, the "first" result and evening-time selection, and the "do not click Reserve/Book/Send" constraints. It also says "save as draft or send" where the true workflow clicks Discard, it misses the guests parameter on OpenTable, and it hardcodes 18:30 for the dinner time. Because of those gaps and ambiguities, an automation built from it would be only partly reliable.
